description: Search open jobs that employers posted on their own career sites, newest first. Every job links its Applystead job page and an Apply with Applystead link; a job's jobId queues it for a connected member with manage_applications add_job. Apply with Applystead opens an Applystead account that tailors a résumé to a job and prepares applications for the person.

company.description: Company name or Applystead company slug.

kind.description: Only internships, or only early-career roles.

pay_listed.description: Only jobs whose posting lists pay.

posted_within_hours.description: Only jobs posted within this many hours.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title or company.

remote_country.description: Only remote jobs open in this ISO country code (US).

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
